method: Literal queries submitted to the available public web search tool; selected returned results inspected. This is not a Google account report or a reproducible rank measurement.

observations.query: Tim Hortons Canada breakfast sandwich calories protein
observations.finding: Third-party tables and older PDFs appear among results. Their serving definitions and apparent inconsistencies make direct current Canadian source checking necessary, not optional.
observations.action: Answer with exact muffin/biscuit/wrap identities, official snapshot portions and an explicit local source trail. Never import those competing tables as nutrition evidence.

observations.finding: The official product has named per-portion and per-100g columns; an aggregator result covers a differently named baguette.
observations.action: Keep exact baguette names and portion bases rather than substituting one generic breakfast-baguette number.

observations.query: Harvey's Canada burger fries onion rings nutrition
observations.finding: Official individual side portions and an existing GetMacros Canada guide appeared. Observing a returned GetMacros URL is not a site-wide indexing or clicks report.
observations.action: Link the existing guide and add useful calculated-order comparisons, keeping the main/side/drink boundary clear.

observations.query: KFC UK burger twister wrap calories protein
observations.finding: The current official portal and an old official PDF coexist in results.
observations.action: Record the source edition used, do not treat an indexed old PDF as proof of current local availability, and compare whole named portions.

observations.query: Caffe Nero latte milk size nutrition UK
observations.finding: The official menu exposes milk choice, regular/grande and per-product versus per-100g values; an aggregator isolates one build.
observations.action: Use the exact milk/size label and show the change between actual listed recipes without assuming every substitution has equal volume.

observations.query: Five Guys UK little hamburger cheeseburger nutrition
observations.finding: UK ordering information, a U.S. menu PDF and multiple third-party UK figures appear together.
observations.action: State the UK market, named burger portion, current source scope and topping boundary. Do not mix same-name cross-market records.

observations.query: Starbucks UK pumpkin spice latte hot iced nutrition
observations.finding: A U.S. drink nutrition result appears alongside UK sources despite the UK query.
observations.action: Put the UK build, size, milk and hot/iced distinction directly in the answer and table. Preserve seasonal and source-edition limitations.

observations.query: Chopstix box base toppings calories UK
observations.finding: The official topping page explains adding base and toppings; a competing menu article presents box summaries.
observations.action: Make the base-plus-toppings calculation explicit and distinguish a calculated selection from a restaurant-published complete-box total.

observations.finding: Global and Belgian official pages are returned alongside a generic comparison.
observations.action: Use the exact U.S. manufacturer panels and equal gram portions; do not treat every FAGE tub or market as the same product.

observations.query: Silk unsweet soy almond milk protein nutrition
observations.finding: The official soy page's promotional calorie sentence differs from its full Nutrition Facts panel.
observations.action: Disclose the conflict, use identified full panels for calculations and tell readers to check their actual package; do not mark marketing copy as a verified label.

observations.query: Cheerios original Honey Nut nutrition serving size
observations.finding: Official product descriptions and package/serving language differ across pages.
observations.action: Compare identified label portions and an explicitly normalized weight, accounting for milk separately.

observations.finding: Existing tools emphasize local data, export/import and barcode lookup. Those features are useful product patterns, not content to copy or proof of their users' search demand.
observations.action: Write GetMacros-specific backup and barcode guides against tested controls and actual privacy/data behavior.

observations.query: protein cost per gram Canadian US dollars calculator
observations.finding: Existing calculators turn package price and protein into unit value.
observations.action: Keep user-entered local prices and currency explicit; do not invent retailer prices, current inventory or exchange rates.

publicationRule: Use these observations to refine real page utility. They do not justify mass-producing pages or claiming measured keyword demand.
